title: Juicy Briny Syrian Kiwifruit Tagine
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring kiwifruit, cooked in a clay pot and served on a bamboo tray, with a briny and juicy flavor profile, this ayurvedic sattvic friendly recipe is perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot over medium heat on a bamboo tray.
Add the olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the clay pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced kiwifruit, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, salt, black pepper, and sumac to the clay pot and stir well.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine for 20 minutes or until the kiwifruit is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with a side of couscous or rice.
To enhance the ayurvedic sattvic friendly properties of the dish, use organic and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
